reason: My diary and my memory already work, and I am at the counter serving people all day. Another thing to check and tap every day, and 500 a month later, when I cannot see it putting money in my till.
objection: Will it really understand my customers' voice notes and Hindi, and will I have to keep fixing its cards? If I have to babysit it, I lose time, not gain money. Also, my udhaar data goes into someone else's system.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work on my own real orders for a few weeks, free, and a shop owner I know saying it actually got him back udhaar money he would have lost.
